analysis:
Examined both complete test-file revisions, the support patch and metadata, and the added work-disk test metadata and bounded orientation excerpt. SandboxStatusTests.swift head lines 78–99 add assertions for external-disk status, omission of a pathless entry, offline guidance, and suppression of an internal-only disk summary. These are display expectations, not evidence of storage authorization or mount validation. SandboxTestSupport.swift head lines 187–201 add a fake installer capability marker and plan-mode stderr; emitted stderr uses the existing shell-word quoting helper at lines 225–227. No production execution, authorization, encryption, billing, or admission control is changed in this supplied test source, and no concrete security regression is supported.
The partial SandboxWorkDiskTests.swift patch introduces APFS/ownership fixtures, external plan data, and path-normalization tests; its remaining source is unavailable here. Integration should reconcile the production --disk option, installer plan/install argument handling, and disk-status decoder/view with these tests. Relevant contracts are TB-013/T-061 and A-019 for owner-account execution, TB-012/T-059 and A-018 for serving availability, and T-041 for any interaction with provider encrypted-cache relocation. Tests do not establish that selected disks preserve mount identity, ownership checks, missing-mount refusal, or cache-key custody. Production implementations and most of the new test file must be examined in the next pass before drawing conclusions about those contracts. This is a coverage limit, not an observed missing control.
